EC.justification: Discriminative candidate scoring over candidate functions emitted by homology/predictors on Swiss-Prot experimentally characterized proteins: unconfirmed candidate ECs on proteins with at least one experimental EC assertion (ECO:0000269) are treated as closed-world negatives (label_basis=closed_world_unconfirmed); unlabelled proteins are excluded.

GO.complex_membership_from_cc: Swiss-Prot experimental GO cellular-component complex terms (GO:0032991 descendants)
GO.explicit_negative_truth: Curator-accepted experimental negatives in complete-locus-labels-v1/negative_reviews.tsv; PMID:15240874, Materials and Methods, Results (Elements in M. jannaschii ThrRS and S. solfataricus ThrRS-cat That Are Responsible for the Specificity of Threonylation), Table 1 and Fig. 3A inset; cloned SSO2486/SSO0384 from ATCC 35092D. Complete only for the two exported GO:0004829/UNSPECIFIED candidates, not all genomic proteins or every assay condition.
GO.justification: Discriminative candidate scoring over candidate GO terms (after is_a/part_of ancestor closure) on Swiss-Prot experimentally characterized proteins: unconfirmed candidate GO terms on proteins with at least one experimental GO assertion (EXP/IDA/IPI/IMP/IGI/IEP/H*) are treated as closed-world negatives (label_basis=closed_world_unconfirmed); unlabelled proteins are excluded.
